archetypes.name: process-group
archetypes.rationale: Step 3 orphan prevention depends on Bash job-control and process-group teardown semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 3 wrapper process lifecycle. Focus on monitor-mode verification, process-group ownership, EXIT trap teardown, and whether any normal or error path can leave run-step3-review.sh descendants alive Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: envelope-contract
archetypes.rationale: Pre-launch failure now bypasses the loop and must preserve existing Step 3 routing contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the fresh panel-failed envelope path. Check that stale result files cannot be replayed and that stdout/result-env keys still route through existing Gate-B-bypass terminal behavior without converting the condition into a hard wrapper failure Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
